source: GL-ai-infra-prices: universe.csv, data/latest.csv (closes), data/fundamentals/quarterly.csv (SEC 10-Q / 10-K revenue and weighted diluted shares)

method.market_value_usd: latest close x the latest quarter's weighted diluted shares
method.ttm_revenue_usd: sum of the last four quarterly revenues, only when they span 330 to 400 days
method.NDX-HIGH-EST: Nasdaq-100 members with a market value, weighted by it (GOOG left out: GOOGL is all of Alphabet)
method.NDX-LOW-EST: every Nasdaq-100 member equal; GOOG and GOOGL share one slot
method.AI-BASKET-EST: AI study-list names with a market value, weighted by it

name.en: Nasdaq-100 high estimate (only the 22 members we could value)

name.zh: 纳斯达克 100 低位估算（全部 100 家成分公司，等权）
